title: Empty-state messages say the wrong thing: 'This folder is empty' under a filter, 'No Results' while a folder is still being indexed, and nothing names the restriction or offers a way out
problem: `render_content` picks the empty text from location alone (src/finder/mod.rs:3236-3264). (1) When a Nushell filter keeps nothing (`rows.retain`, src/finder/filter.rs:96-109) a folder full of files shows 'No Items / This folder is empty.' and a search shows 'No Results', although `unfiltered_len` is known (mod.rs:1260) and the status bar correctly says '0 of N items pass the filter' (src/finder/bars.rs:340-345). (2) 'Indexing...' is shown only when `self.indexing_progress()` is Some, which reflects the configured roots (`engine.status()` lists `roots` only, crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:400-406). A search scoped to a folder outside every root builds a temporary index (engine.rs:476-507; manual.md:333) and the response says so (`indexing`, engine.rs:520 -> `SearchStats.indexing`, mod.rs:1414), but the message ignores that flag and reads 'No Results. Try a different name, kind, or search location.' for as long as the scan takes; the default root is only the home folder (config.rs:435-437), so every external volume, /usr, /opt and so on hits this. (3) 'No Results' always says 'Try a different name, kind, or search location.' whatever is actually restricting the search; in Contents mode it still suggests a different kind, a control that is disabled there (bars.rs:166). (4) The Kind filter is easy to trip over: `set_kind` saves it (`config.kind_filter` + `settings_changed`, mod.rs:1470-1476; a persisted per-tab setting, crates/fffinder-core/src/config.rs:619) and opening a Smart Folder overwrites it (filter.rs:226-227), so a later unrelated search is silently limited to e.g. Images. The only sign is the Kind button's label, drawn in the same outline style for 'Any Kind' and a real restriction (bars.rs:159-182), unlike the scope and Name/Contents chips, which turn accent-coloured when on (bars.rs:36-51). (5) A folder-scoped search that finds nothing offers no shortcut to widen it.
proposal: In src/finder/mod.rs extract a pure `fn empty_state(input: EmptyInput) -> EmptyState { title, detail, actions }` (inputs: searching, contents, query, scope is Folder plus folder name, kind, `search_stats.indexing`, `indexing_progress()`, filter active, `unfiltered_len`, location kind) and call it from `render_content`. Rules: filter active and `unfiltered_len > 0` -> 'No Items Pass the Filter' / 'N items are hidden by the filter.' with a Remove Filter button calling `close_filter`; searching and `stats.indexing` -> 'Indexing...' using the root count when there is one, otherwise 'Indexing <Folder>. Results appear when it finishes.'; contents search -> 'No files contain <query>' with the hint mentioning the size and time limits in Settings instead of kind; name search -> 'No Results for <query>' with a detail naming the scope folder and the kind when restricted, plus up to three buttons, each only when applicable: 'Search This Computer' (`scope == Folder` -> `set_scope(SearchScope::Computer, cx)`), 'Any Kind' (`kind_filter != Any && !search_contents` -> `set_kind(KindFilter::Any, cx)`), 'Search Contents' / 'Search Names' (`set_search_contents`). `render_message` already takes an extra button child (the Full Disk Access case, mod.rs:3224-3234). Give the title an id (`empty-title`) and the buttons ids (`empty-widen-scope`, `empty-any-kind`, `empty-contents`, `empty-remove-filter`) with `.test_support()`. In src/finder/bars.rs tint the Kind button with the accent colour, as the chips do (bars.rs:42-48), when `kind != KindFilter::Any`. Update the message table in docs/manual.md:120-128.
original_test_plan: Unit tests for `empty_state` beside the `IndexActivity` tests (mod.rs:3432-3474): one case per rule, including indexing-with-no-root-progress and filter-hid-everything in a folder and in a search. Headless UI tests in tests/controls.rs. Scope (extending 333-345): `go_to(Projects)`, turn on folder scope, `set_query("budget")`; assert `ui.exists("empty-widen-scope")`, click it, assert `search_scope() == Computer` and `ui.names() == ["Budget.csv"]`. Kind: `set_query("roadmap")`, `set_kind(KindFilter::Folder)`; assert `ui.exists("empty-any-kind")`, click, assert names == [Roadmap.md] and `config().kind_filter == Any`. Filter (skipped without nu, like controls.rs:1416-1426): filter `size > 1gb` in the fixture folder; assert the `empty-title` label mentions the filter and not 'empty', click `empty-remove-filter`, assert 4 names.
original_risks: The message must not flash while a search or first filter run is in flight: keep the `!self.loading && !self.searching` guard and also skip while `is_filtering()`. `render_message` returns a plain Div used by other states; add the buttons only for the search/filter cases. The 'Search This Computer' button should not appear in Recents or other non-folder locations, and 'Any Kind' only for name searches (contents searches ignore Kind). Wording changes touch the manual's message table. Reviewers proposed slightly different titles and button ids; one set is given here. Putting the Kind back after a Smart Folder is in smart-folder-save-and-leaks; the temporary-index retry behind rule 2 is in adhoc-index-feedback; the collapsed-groups and right-click fixes for the same branch are in collapsed-groups-empty-view.

verifier.claim_check:
Every factual claim holds; some of the framing is overstated and the effort is underestimated.

(1) TRUE. src/finder/mod.rs:3236-3264 chooses the text from `is_searching()` and the location only. `rebuild_rows` records `unfiltered_len` (mod.rs:1260) and then `apply_filter_to` (src/finder/filter.rs:96-109) retains only `filter_keep`. A filter that keeps nothing therefore shows "No Items / This folder is empty." in a folder and "No Results" in a search, while src/finder/bars.rs:340-345 says "0 of N items pass the filter". The filter also survives navigation (`navigate`, mod.rs:893-898, never clears it), so the stale `filter_keep` hides every row of the next folder and "This folder is empty." flashes until `nu` finishes.

(2) TRUE, slightly overstated. `indexing_progress()` (mod.rs:1536) reads `index_status`, which is `engine.status()`, roots only (crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:400-406). A folder-scoped search outside every root starts a temporary index (engine.rs:476-507). fff-search publishes the empty picker before scanning (fff-search-0.11.0/src/file_picker.rs:974-985), so `search` returns at once with no hits and `indexing: true` (engine.rs:520, 599; contents path engine.rs:866). The UI stores this in `SearchStats.indexing` (mod.rs:1414, 3024), but the message ignores it. The retry loop polls `roots_indexing()` (mod.rs:1442-1445), which also skips temporary indexes, so it re-searches every 600 ms. The user sees "No Results" with a brief skeleton each retry, not one unbroken message. Folder scope must be chosen explicitly (default is Computer, mod.rs:549), and small folders scan in milliseconds. docs/manual.md:125 and :333 show "Indexing…" is the intended message, so this is a bug.

(3) TRUE. The hint is the fixed string at mod.rs:3248, and Kind is disabled for contents (bars.rs:166). `SearchStats.stopped` is ignored too.

(4) TRUE but intentional. `set_kind` persists (mod.rs:1470-1476); `kind_filter` is a documented per-tab setting (config.rs:619, manual.md:1075, CHANGELOG.md:78). A Smart Folder overwrites it (filter.rs:226). The Kind button is always plain outline (bars.rs:159-182). "Silently" is too strong: the button label shows the kind, and the hint says "kind".

(5) TRUE but weak. There is no button in the message, yet the "This Computer" chip sits in the scope bar directly above (bars.rs:74-84).

No test pins the current strings: tests/ has no match for "No Results", "No Items" or "Indexing…". The manual table at docs/manual.md:120-128 is the only documentation to update.
verifier.implementation_notes:
Keep the pure-function design, with these corrections.

**1. Pure function in src/finder/mod.rs**
- Add `struct EmptyInput<'a>` with plain data: `place` (Folder / Recents / Trash / Other, from `history.current()`), `query: &str` (empty means not searching), `contents`, `scope_folder: Option<String>`, `kind: KindFilter`, `indexing: bool`, `indexed_so_far: Option<usize>`, `stopped: bool`, `filtered: bool`, `unfiltered_len`, `capped`.
- Add `enum EmptyAction { RemoveFilter, SearchComputer, AnyKind }` and `fn empty_state(&EmptyInput) -> EmptyState { title, detail, actions: Vec<EmptyAction> }`.
- `scope_folder` is Some only when `scope == SearchScope::Folder && current_folder().is_some()`. `run_search` (mod.rs:1368-1371) already treats folder scope in Recents as Computer.
- `filtered` must be `!filter.is_empty() && filter_error.is_none()`, the same test the status bar uses (bars.rs:329).
- `indexing` is `search_stats.indexing`; `indexed_so_far` is `indexing_progress()`.

**2. Rule order**
- a. `filtered && unfiltered_len > 0`: "No Items Pass the Filter" / "N items are hidden by the filter." (add `+` when capped), action `RemoveFilter`. This covers folders, searches, Recents and Trash.
- b. Searching and (`indexing` or `indexed_so_far.is_some()`): "Indexing…". Use the union so the documented root case (manual.md:125) is unchanged. With a count, keep today's wording. Without one, say "Indexing “Folder”. Results appear when it finishes."
- c. Searching with contents: "No files contain “q”". If `stopped`, say the search stopped at the time limit; otherwise mention the file-size and time limits in Settings › Search engine (manual.md:1000-1001). Never mention kind. Offer `SearchComputer` if scoped.
- d. Searching by name: "No Results for “q”", with a detail naming the scope folder and/or `kind.label()` when restricted. Offer `SearchComputer` if scoped and `AnyKind` if `kind != Any`.
- e. Recents, Trash and Folder strings stay as they are.
- Drop the proposed "Search Contents" / "Search Names" button. It is a mode switch, not a restriction, and the chips are directly above.

**3. `render_content` (mod.rs:3236)**
- Change the guard to `rows.is_empty() && !loading && !searching && !self.is_filtering()`. While a filter runs, the existing skeleton/columns branches show; this also removes today's "This folder is empty." flash after navigating with a filter on.
- Optional: keep the Indexing message up when `searching` is true and the last `search_stats.indexing` was true, so it does not blink against the skeleton on each 600 ms retry.
- Render with `render_message(...)` plus one wrapping, centred `h_flex` of small Buttons, as the `trash-disk-access` case does (mod.rs:3224-3234).

**4. Buttons and ids**
- Button ids: `empty-remove-filter` calls `close_filter(window, cx)`; `empty-widen-scope` calls `set_scope(SearchScope::Computer, cx)`; `empty-any-kind` calls `set_kind(KindFilter::Any, cx)`.
- Buttons are already found by id in the harness (`empty-trash`, `close-filter` have no `.test_support()`), so do not add it.
- gpui-kit Buttons own a focus handle (gpui-component-0.8.1/src/button/button.rs:652) and vanish once results arrive. Call `this.focus_files(window, cx)` in the scope and kind handlers, as `close_filter` already does, or the keyboard goes dead.
- In `render_message`, give the title `div().id("empty-title").aria_label(title).test_support()`, the pattern at src/finder/preview_pane.rs:75-80. Truncate long queries.

**5. Kind tint in src/finder/bars.rs:160**
- Add `.primary()` to the outline button when `kind != KindFilter::Any && !contents`. Outline + primary is an existing accent-tinted variant (button.rs:951-959). Use `.map` or an `if` if `.when` is not available on Button.

**6. Docs**
- Update the table at docs/manual.md:120-128 (it also lacks the existing Trash row) and add an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md.

**Out of scope**
- Kind persistence, the Smart Folder overwrite, and the `roots_indexing` retry loop belong to the sibling candidates.
verifier.test_plan:
**Unit tests** in the `tests` module at src/finder/mod.rs:3432. Import `empty_state`, `EmptyInput` and `EmptyAction` explicitly; the module deliberately avoids `super::*`. One case per rule:
- Filter hid everything in a folder and in a search: title has no "empty", action is `RemoveFilter`.
- Filter on but `unfiltered_len == 0`: plain "No Items".
- Indexing with a root count, and indexing with no count (temporary index): the detail names the folder.
- Contents search: no "kind" in the detail and no `AnyKind`; the `stopped` variant mentions the time limit.
- Name search with scope and kind restricted: both actions offered. Unrestricted: no actions.
- Recents and Trash unchanged.

The temporary-index case cannot be made deterministic in the headless harness, because the fixture scans instantly. The unit test is its only coverage.

**Headless UI tests** in tests/controls.rs, using `Fixture` and `Ui` from tests/common/mod.rs:
- Scope, extending `search_scope_button` (controls.rs:328-358) or a new test: `ui.go_to(&fx.path("Projects"))`, `ui.click("search-scope")`, `ui.update(|f,_,cx| f.set_query("budget".into(), true, cx))`. Assert `ui.names().is_empty()` and `ui.exists("empty-widen-scope")`. Then `ui.click("empty-widen-scope")` and assert `search_scope() == SearchScope::Computer`, `ui.names() == ["Budget.csv"]` and `ui.files_focused()`.
- Kind: `set_query("roadmap")`, then `ui.update(|f,_,cx| f.set_kind(KindFilter::Folder, cx))`. First assert `ui.names().is_empty()` as a precondition: Allow typos is on by default, so pick another query if a fuzzy folder match appears. Assert `ui.exists("empty-any-kind")` and `!ui.exists("empty-widen-scope")`. Click it and assert `config().kind_filter == KindFilter::Any` and `ui.names() == ["Roadmap.md"]`. Switch to `by-contents` with an unmatched query and assert `!ui.exists("empty-any-kind")`.
- Filter, skipped without nu like `nushell_filter_and_smart_folders` (controls.rs:1416-1430, `Open { nu: Some(nu), .. }`): `ui.press(&cmd("alt-f"))`, `ui.type_text("size > 1gb")`, `ui.press("enter")`. Assert `ui.names().is_empty()` and that `ui.snapshot("empty-title").label()` contains "Filter" and not "empty". Click `empty-remove-filter` and assert `ui.names().len() == 4`, `filter_text() == ""` and `!ui.exists("filter-input")`.
- Plain empty folder: create an empty directory in the fixture, `go_to` it, and assert `empty-title` is "No Items" with none of the three button ids present.
verifier.risks:
- **Flashing message.** Without the `!is_filtering()` guard, the filter message appears on every re-run with a stale `filter_keep`, for example after navigating with a filter on.
- **Blinking during indexing.** The Indexing message alternates with the skeleton on each 600 ms retry unless it is kept up while `searching` and the last stats said indexing.
- **Lost keyboard focus.** A clicked gpui-kit Button takes focus and is then removed when results arrive. The handlers must call `focus_files`.
- **Narrow panes.** The button row must wrap and long queries in the title must truncate; the message is capped at 420 points.
- **Root-indexing regression.** Rule 2 as originally written (`stats.indexing` only) could change the documented root case. Use the union with `indexing_progress()`.
- **Shared helper.** `render_message` also serves the "Can't open this folder" / Trash error state, so the title id is shared and the buttons must not leak into it.
- **Wrong button in Recents.** `SearchComputer` must depend on `current_folder().is_some()`, not on `scope` alone.
- **Scope creep.** Three buttons duplicate scope-bar controls, so the value is mostly in the filter and indexing wording. Keep the buttons small and at most two at once.
- **Untested paths.** The Kind tint is visual only and cannot be asserted in the harness; the temporary-index message is covered by the unit test only.
- **Unverified.** I did not run cargo (read-only review), so the fuzzy-match precondition in the Kind test is not confirmed.

orchestrator_notes: From the reviewer of 'search-truncation-honesty' (on the trunk): a search that was cut short and lists nothing must never read 'No Results'. One such case is still there: a contents search in a folder with a space in its path shows 'No Results' beside '0+ items' (picture: /home/user/polish-tools/shots/search-truncation-honesty-review-folder-with-space-crowded.png). 'scoped-search-special-folder-names' fixes the search itself; make the message honest for any search whose results were cut ('+' in the count) and that lists nothing.
